build.name: 1993 configure + make with modern-compiler accommodations (-fcommon -std=gnu89 -w; no source change)
build.cmd: ./configure >/dev/null 2>&1; make -s CFLAGS='-O1 -fcommon -std=gnu89 -w' 2>&1 | grep -iE '\berror' | head -5; test -x ./gzip && echo built

runs.name: round trip the same 200 KB sample used for compact; report the ratio
runs.cmd: awk 'BEGIN{for(i=0;i<4000;i++) printf("the quick brown fox %d jumps over the lazy dog %d\n", i, i*7)}' > $BODY/build/sample && ./gzip -c -9 $BODY/build/sample > $BODY/build/s.gz && ls -l $BODY/build/s.gz | awk '{print "gzip -9 bytes:", $5}' && ./gzip -dc $BODY/build/s.gz | cmp - $BODY/build/sample && echo ROUNDTRIP OK

notes: Same sample as compact-4.2bsd-1983 so the two ratios are comparable.
